text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While visiting the shopping mall
to do some shopping—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAH!! Special training, start!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't bump into anyone! Fast walking!
*Swish*... *swish-swish-swish*!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Phew~~! Total success!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What are you even doing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Taishin~~!
Right now, I'm doing special training to weave swiftly through crowds!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The other day Hayahide was doing it super seriously.
I'm sure this is the secret to her strength!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's definitely not. Seriously.
You're just gonna hurt yourself.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you're worried about me! But don't worry!
I'll definitely master it, just watch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This time, even faster!
*Zip-zip*... *zip-zip-zip*——... Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: OUCHIEEEE!! I ran into a wall!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Owwie~! It hurts, but I'm fine!
I won't give up! I'll get back up no matter how many times it takes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hayahide!
I'm doing the special training you were doing the other day!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know, the thing where you weave through crowds like *zip-zip-zip*.
Turning even stores into a training ground—that's so like you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The other day? ...No.
That had nothing to do with training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At that time... well...
I simply wanted to read the academic journal I purchased as soon as possible...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAAT!?
So you just wanted to get home quickly!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Don't tell me, the time Taishin only stepped on the white stripes of the crosswalk was also...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? When did you see that—
I mean, of course that has nothing to do with training!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No waaay~~!?
And here I was planning on doing that next~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just thought, as a rival to both of you,
I needed to build up way, way more ability...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As a rival, huh... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do rivals really need all these roundabout gimmicks
to push each other higher?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Running. That's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Running! OOOOOOH...!
THAT'S ITTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're right, all we gotta do is run!
Just like we always do, with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go!
Ready, SET, GOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
Nobody said right now!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... However, taking a loss like this wouldn't sit well.
I have no choice but to accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sigh*, jeez.
Guess I have no choice...
